# Crusader Kings III mods

Mods by Jeremy Barnes (nchelix), with full documentation and every released version.
Each mod's page explains what it does and how to use it; the [Releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases) page has a ready-to-install zip of every version.
